actual_wire_bytes: The client measured network_bytes_in as 56 bytes per acknowledged frame: 32-byte ACK header plus 24-byte timing and memory metrics.
finding: The original receiver JSONL logged ack_bytes_out as the 32-byte protocol header only.
interpretation: The archived JSONL field is incomplete. Use the corresponding client CSV for total network traffic; do not use archived ack_bytes_out alone as total response bytes.
source_status: The receiver JSONL logger now records ack_bytes_out=56 and separately records 32 header bytes and 24 metrics bytes. The fixed source was optimized-compiled and exercised in a separate smoke run; instrumentation-fix-smoke.jsonl records the corrected values. Original baseline JSONL evidence is unchanged.
summary_basis: CSV network byte totals use the client measured sendall/receive byte lengths and include the complete 56-byte response.
validation_status: Native synthetic protocol only; Wine, Windows guest, D3D workload and real game remain unverified.
